assessment.requirement: Dedicated plugin/startup behavior and applicable loading gates.
assessment.conclusion: The proof descriptor is disabled by default and selected for the dedicated target. Its absent ExplicitlyLoaded field is distinct from explicit false; the reviewed runtime descriptor constructor supplies false and the native reader preserves it when absent. Default startup calls project loading before eligible plugin loading and propagates failures to startup. Module eligibility still depends on build/runtime configuration, phase and already-loaded state. Explicit mounting is a separate conditional route whose success return does not certify successful module activation.
assessment.qualification: Custom descriptor-reader hooks, configuration gates, binary preloading and explicit mounting remain conditional framework paths. No universal all-plugins execution or activation claim is made.
